title: JOIN US! - Women’s Council of Realtors for "We See You,"
description:
Join the Women’s Council of Realtors for "We See You," a branding and presence experience in downtown Killeen. This is more than networking; it’s a full experience designed for connection and creativity.
This is so much more than networking — it's a full experience designed for connection, creativity, and confidence! ✨
 What's waiting for you: 
Professional Photos — Get a lifestyle headshot with Kinetic Images! 
Expert Branding — Gain clarity on your message and professional edge! 
Wellness & Finance — Real-life tips from specialized coaches! 
Hat Bar — Create a custom piece to take home! 
📅 When: Thursday, May 21st, 2026 
📍 Where: Downtown Killeen 
We can't wait to see YOU! 💛✨
